svg.aria-label: About. Full-stack engineer, mostly on the backend: public APIs, webhooks into ERPs and automations with LLMs. On my own time I build systems that keep running when nobody is watching, from a Game Boy emulator in Go to an agent with persistent memory. now: Visão, a cognitive architecture with memory. goal: Relocate to the Netherlands / EU. beyond code: Late nights, rain, The Neighbourhood.
